name: 95614 · Cool, CA
findings: ZIP 95614 (Cool) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95614 (Cool) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95614 (Cool) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95614 (Cool) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
